newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Philips wins cable contract extension.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Philips wins cable contract extension.

text.p: Philips Electronic Australia, a unit of Philips Electronics, said on Tuesday it had been awarded a contract extension worth A$400 million with state-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp to supply equipment for Telstra's cable rollout.
"The contract extension is with Phillips and is valued at about A$400 million," said Garry McCarten, general manager of Phillips Electronics Australia.
McCarten said the contract was for the continuing supply of the total range of equipment required for Telstra's cable network from 1997 through to 1999.
Hw said the extension effectively doubled the size of the existing contract between Phillips and Telstra which started in April 1994.
